attempts.detail: A repeated normal run exposed a cancellation-test timing assumption and a constructor timeout-classification race. The tests now use a later echo barrier to establish a settled local write before late-response reuse. Dial failures now preserve safe deadline/cancellation evidence from errors.Is/net.Error even when HTTP transport timeout occurs before ctx.Err publication. Thirty focused repetitions and complete final normal/repeated-normal/race reruns subsequently passed.

Full normal run passed in 17.179 seconds before read-only review found a coalesced-read prefix-loss issue in the new strict frame guard. The guard now returns the preceding valid response bytes and retains a sticky ErrProtocol for the invalid suffix. This earlier run is not the final changed-tree gate.
